content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] with firmware [version_no] and a [product_name] with firmware [version_no], both connected through a [product_name] switch. analysis.insight_summary: The main issue was a failed secure connection between two [product_name] devices due to a certificate verification error, even with proper configuration and synchronized times. Updating the firmware on the devices resolved the compatibility issue, indicating that firmware versions may impact secure connection establishment.
